reviewed_by: Automated static review (Binary Ninja + Radare2 CFG, signature, behaviour note)

runtime_contract.note: The live differential compares the calls that naturally happened, with the argument words and the result of each call. A pointer value from one process is not the data of the other, so a non-scalar argument is compared as the word it was, and the report says which scope it used.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Retail 0x004B1E90 (String_FindExtension): edx=path; ecx=strlen(path); if ecx: while path[ecx]!='.': ecx--; if ecx==0 break; esi=path+ecx; if out: call 0x4a5500(out,esi,size-1); out[size-1]=0; ret esi. The candidate is the same instruction sequence in C++ using the retail global addresses. No Frida run yet.
